data.heading: Where it started
data.description: Intelligence on vendor relationships worth billions, spread across five disconnected systems.

blocks.title: Business problem
blocks.body: Analysts spent 15 to 20 hours a week per vendor pulling data together by hand, and a single briefing took two to three business days. Negotiations and renewals ran on outdated information, and adding vendor coverage required proportional headcount growth as the portfolio expanded.

blocks.title: No decision framework
blocks.body: Financial, procurement, research, news, and spreadsheet data sat in separate places with no single source of truth. Spend by business unit or cost center arrived in monthly reports, so overspend, unfavorable renewals, vendor financial risk, and pricing shifts surfaced weeks or months after they mattered.

blocks.title: Agivant's role
blocks.body: Engineering partner across strategy, architecture, dashboard design, full-stack development, LLM integration, and knowledge transfer

data.heading: What Agivant built
data.description: Agivant worked with vendor strategy leadership to tie every feature to a business outcome, then built the full platform on the client's in-house large language model. VIBE writes vendor research on demand, pulls live spend from the procurement system, and refreshes its own content before it goes stale. Value in days and weeks.

blocks.title: Unified intelligence dashboard
blocks.body: Complete profiles for 20+ strategic vendors, with highlights, briefings, spend detail, and research in one tabbed view and instant vendor switching.

blocks.title: AI-powered research automation
blocks.body: The in-house LLM writes executive summaries, strategic briefs, financial health assessments, technology roadmaps, competitive positioning, and risk signals.

blocks.title: Real-time spend intelligence
blocks.body: Live POs, cost-center filtering, and active and year-to-date spend straight from the procurement system, with one-click export for finance.

blocks.title: Proactive intelligence engine
blocks.body: Checks content freshness every 24 hours, regenerates anything stale, and alerts analysts to material changes.

blocks.title: Retrieval and knowledge layer
blocks.body: RAG retrieval over a vendor knowledge graph, vector database, and document store, feeding QBR reports and an AI query interface.

rows.label: AI engine
rows.value: The client's in-house large language model, at zero external AI cost

rows.label: Knowledge store
rows.value: RAG retrieval, vendor knowledge graph, vector database, document store

rows.label: Data ingestion
rows.value: Manus AI orchestration, document parsing, API connectors, research and financial feeds

rows.label: Caching
rows.value: Generated-output cache with a five-day lifetime

rows.label: Controls
rows.value: SSO, role-based access control, secret management

blocks.title: Before
blocks.body: Five-plus disconnected systems, manual research, and spend visible only in monthly reports.

blocks.title: After
blocks.body: One dashboard backed by an in-house LLM, live procurement data, a knowledge layer, and a cache-first request flow with scheduled refresh.

data.heading: Proof in production
data.description: An analyst opens a vendor and gets highlights, a briefing, spend detail, and research in one view. A cache hit returns instantly. On a miss, the AI engine combines the LLM with live web search, generates the brief, and caches it for the next request. In the background, a scheduler checks freshness every 24 hours and regenerates anything stale before anyone asks for it.

blocks.heading: Measured results
blocks.description: Coverage now grows with the vendor portfolio, without proportional headcount growth.

blocks.label: Vendor briefing, previously 2 to 3 business days
Vendors per analyst, up from 2 to 3

blocks.title: Reusable asset
blocks.body: The cache-first generation pattern, prompt-governed LLM output with scheduled freshness checks, carries to any intelligence domain where research goes stale, and coverage scales from 20+ vendors to 100+ on the same platform. Every build amplifies the next.

blocks.title: Challenges overcome
blocks.body: Running core intelligence on the client's in-house LLM at zero external AI cost, bringing live procurement data into a research tool while keeping sensitive spend behind role-based access, and handing over documentation and runbooks so the client team owns the platform long term.
